headline: President Obama changed Executive Order 12777, an earlier order that assigns federal duties for handling oil and chemical spills in water.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12777. That earlier order divides up the President's powers under federal water pollution and oil spill laws among federal agencies. The title alone does not say which specific duties were changed or moved.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that handle oil and chemical spill rules
who_it_affects.how: Their assigned duties under Executive Order 12777 may have been changed or shifted, though the details are not given here.
